sampling_section: 推荐采样参数 / instruct mode
generation_config_note: The model generation_config.json has different defaults (temperature 1.0, top_k 20); this trial explicitly uses the documented instruct recommendation, not those defaults.
repeat_last_n_note: llama.cpp repeat-last-n=-1 covers the context rather than its default last 64 tokens; penalty semantics are not claimed to be bitwise identical to Transformers.
